summary.en: One day, as Ayumi runs in the street, she hurts herself when she falls so a lady walking nearby, Saki Midorikawa, goes to help her and bring her home in her apartment to heal her and offers her orange juice. Ayumi thought she was nice. Saki then went to the window to smoke and look over the building in front of hers. After the Detective Boys leave Saki, they think about solving a case and just at the same moment, a car out of control parades in the street before crashing in the building next to the gym where Saki trains. Just after going to the sports center, Saki returns home and waits at a streetlight before being pushed into traffic and yells. The Detective Boys hear what happens and go help her. She nearly got ran over by a truck. The next morning, Ogi is standing outside the building waving goodbye to residents and sees Dojima searching for something on the floor. As she says she hasn't find it, Saki's corpse fall from the top of the building before crashing down.
